tools.name: purge_run_and_notify_webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a run's local artifact directory and its database record, then posts a deletion notice to the team's webhook.

params.name: run_id
params.description: ID of the run to delete

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the deletion notice

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import requests

DATABASE_FILE_LOCATION = "/var/lib/tracker/tracker.db"
ARTIFACT_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/lib/tracker/artifacts")


def purge_run_and_notify_webhook(run_id: str, webhook_url: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_LOCATION)
    try:
        matching_run_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT name, experiment_id FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if matching_run_row is None:
            return {"deleted": False, "error": f"Run {run_id} not found"}

        run_display_name, parent_experiment_identifier = matching_run_row
        run_artifact_directory_path = ARTIFACT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / run_id

        number_of_artifact_files_removed = 0
        if run_artifact_directory_path.is_dir():
            number_of_artifact_files_removed = sum(
                1 for each_path in run_artifact_directory_path.rglob("*") if each_path.is_file()
            )
            shutil.rmtree(run_artifact_directory_path)

        database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM metrics WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
        database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,))
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    notification_payload_dictionary = {
        "text": f"Run '{run_display_name}' ({run_id}) from experiment {parent_experiment_identifier} was deleted.",
        "files_removed": number_of_artifact_files_removed,
    }
    webhook_response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=notification_payload_dictionary, timeout=10)

    return {
        "deleted": True,
        "files_removed": number_of_artifact_files_removed,
        "webhook_status": webhook_response.status_code,
    }

tools.name: run_training_script_and_archive_outputs
tools.description: Runs a training script in a subprocess and then moves its output files into the archive folder for the given run.

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the Python training script

params.name: run_id
params.description: Run ID used to name the archive folder

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory the script writes its outputs to

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("experiment-tracker")

ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/var/lib/tracker/archive")


@dataclass
class TrainingResult:
    exit_code: int
    archive_path: str
    files_moved: list = field(default_factory=list)
    stderr_tail: str = ""


@mcp.tool()
def run_training_script_and_archive_outputs(script_path: str, run_id: str, output_dir: str) -> dict:
    script = Path(script_path)
    source_dir = Path(output_dir)
    if not script.is_file():
        return {"error": f"Script not found: {script_path}"}

    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(script), "--output-dir", str(source_dir)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=3600,
    )

    destination = ARCHIVE_ROOT / run_id
    result = TrainingResult(
        exit_code=proc.returncode,
        archive_path=str(destination),
        stderr_tail=proc.stderr[-500:],
    )

    if proc.returncode != 0 or not source_dir.is_dir():
        return result.__dict__

    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for item in source_dir.iterdir():
        target = destination / item.name
        shutil.move(str(item), str(target))
        result.files_moved.append(item.name)

    return result.__dict__
